segmentler.metin: The Lahaina fire destroyed the town of Lahaina on Maui.
It took only a downed power line igniting dry grass in high winds.
So how could a downed power line igniting dry grass in high winds do this?
The answer is wind-driven fire, failing hydrant pressure and no siren warning — and it is why Maui faced scrutiny over warnings, water and grid safety.
